more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Copper complexes of chlorophylls and chlorophyllins is used as a color in food. Its technological role is to add or restore food colour.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include ripened cheese, dried fruit and vegetables, fruit and vegetables in vinegar oil or brine, canned or bottled fruit and vegetables. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Plant chlorophyll extracts are treated with copper salts. For the chlorophyllin form, alkaline processing also removes parts of the original pigment molecule before the copper complex is made.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The specified starting material is plant derived and compatible with vegetarian and vegan diets. The specification does not establish halal or kosher certification.
